sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule XII, Section 1204 — Lathing and Plastering
sources.description: Governs lath types, plaster mix proportions, thickness requirements, application methods, and curing for both interior and exterior plastering.

sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule XII, Sec. 1204.3 — Plaster Thickness Requirements
sources.description: Minimum plaster thickness requirements by application: 3-coat work on metal lath, 2-coat on masonry, etc.

sources.label: ASTM C926 — Standard Specification for Application of Portland Cement-Based Plaster
sources.description: Industry standard referenced in Philippine practice for proper plaster application methods and material specifications.
